info.name: Wings of the Avariel
info.description: The construction for my custom Wings of the Avariel.
info.author: Gustavo Schip

description.p: Crafted from the wings of a young Avariel, these delicate feathers still carry a trace of their innate magic. Though smaller than those of a fully grown Avariel, they can be worn and attuned to by a creature capable of bearing them.

While attuned to the wings, you have a pair of wings that grant you a flying speed of 15 feet. Broad and feathered, they can span up to 5 feet when fully extended. To use this flying speed, you can't be wearing armor
